raw_text:
Priya Menon
priya.menon.dev@gmail.com | +91 98xxxxxx08 | github.com/priyamenon | Kochi
SUMMARY
Full stack developer proficient in the MERN stack with two internships and multiple deployed projects. Comfortable
with agile workflows, testing, and cloud basics.
EDUCATION
B.Tech Computer Science, National Institute of Technology Karnataka (2023-2027), CGPA: 9.1/10
SKILLS
JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Git, Docker, AWS
(EC2, S3, basic Lambda), Jest, Agile/Scrum
EXPERIENCE
Full Stack Intern, BrightPath Technologies (Dec 2025-Feb 2026)
•
Built and shipped 3 features on a production Node.js/Express + React application
•
Wrote unit and integration tests using Jest, maintaining >80% coverage on new code
•
Participated in 2-week sprints, daily standups, and sprint retrospectives
Software Intern, CodeCrafters Startup (Jun-Jul 2025)
•
Migrated part of a legacy jQuery frontend to React components
PROJECTS
SkillBridge - Peer Mentorship Platform
•
Full stack MERN app with React frontend, Node/Express backend, MongoDB database
•
Containerized with Docker; deployed on AWS EC2 with an S3 bucket for file uploads
CERTIFICATIONS
AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials, Agile Development Specialization (Coursera)
